label: Lens
description: Focal length and aperture character — each item is one committed lens choice with its perspective behavior named.

items.name: 85mm-f12
items.text: shot on an 85mm f/1.2 portrait lens, flattering telephoto compression on the features, a razor-thin focus plane locked to the eyes and the background melted to featureless color

items.name: 50mm-f14
items.text: shot on a 50mm f/1.4, perspective matching the human eye, gentle subject separation with the background softened but still legible

items.name: 135mm-compression
items.text: shot on a 135mm telephoto, strong perspective compression stacking the background tight behind the subject, distant layers rendered large and flat

items.name: 35mm-environmental
items.text: shot on a 35mm lens, mild wide perspective keeping the subject in believable proportion to a readable environment, breathing space around the story

items.name: 24mm-wide
items.text: shot on a 24mm wide angle, near-far exaggeration pulling foreground objects large, sweeping depth from boots to horizon with slight stretch at the frame edges

items.name: 14mm-ultrawide
items.text: shot on a 14mm ultra-wide, extreme near-far exaggeration, converging verticals and stretched corners one step from abstraction

items.name: 600mm-telephoto
items.text: shot on a 600mm super-telephoto, perspective flattened to parallel planes, heat-shimmer distance and buttery far bokeh isolating the subject completely

items.name: 100mm-macro
items.text: shot on a 100mm macro lens at 1:1, wafer-thin focus, surface textures resolved into landscapes

items.name: anamorphic
items.text: shot anamorphic, vertically stretched oval bokeh, horizontal cyan flares streaking off point lights and widescreen cinema geometry

items.name: fisheye
items.text: shot on an 8mm fisheye, the horizon bowing through the frame and every straight line curving away from center, 180-degree coverage pulling near objects into comic bulge

items.name: tilt-shift-lens
items.text: shot on a tilt-shift lens with the plane of focus tilted off the sensor, a knife-edge diagonal band of sharpness slicing through the scene while everything above and below it melts at the same distance

items.name: vintage-glass
items.text: shot on uncoated vintage glass, haze-lifted low contrast, swirling cat's-eye bokeh toward the edges and highlights blooming into soft glow

items.name: f8-deep
items.text: stopped down to f/8 at the lens's sweet spot, critical sharpness from foreground grit to horizon with no bokeh to hide behind, the composition carrying the whole frame

items.name: catadioptric
items.text: shot on a 500mm catadioptric mirror lens at its fixed f/8, flat stacked telephoto perspective and every out-of-focus highlight rendered as a bright-edged donut ring

items.name: soft-focus-portrait
items.text: shot on a classic soft-focus portrait lens, a sharp image core wrapped in spherical-aberration glow, highlights blooming while real detail survives underneath

items.name: probe-macro
items.text: shot on a cylindrical probe lens pushed inside the scene, wide-angle perspective at macro distance, the nearest object looming huge centimeters away while the whole environment stays readable behind it
